name: Unwahrheit
source:
After receiving an anonymous 'love' letter, a desire for a new romance sparks within Reina. The mystery of its sender sends her searching for answers at her house party. Three men stand out—each with their own charm, each a potential contender for her heart.

But is the letter from one of them? Or could it hide a darker secret, one that has nothing to do with love at all?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3531660/Unwahrheit/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
收到一封匿名“情书”后，Reina心中燃起了对新恋情的渴望。为了查出写信人的身份，她在自家派对上寻找答案。三位男子格外引人注目，各有魅力，也都可能赢得她的心。

但这封信真是其中一人写的吗？还是藏着更黑暗、与爱情毫无关系的秘密？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3531660/Unwahrheit/]Steam[/url]]
